answer: Registration requires each agent to lock a stake and sign a fresh random challenge with a unique hardware key. A Sybil attacker must fund a new bond for every fake identity, so cost rises linearly while rewards get split, making clones unprofitable. Random audits demand an on-the-spot signature; a reused or missing key slashes the whole bond. The ledger is a crystal record, each identity a quill that signs once, and checks spiral outward so no single forgery stays hidden.
